Introduction

Hi! My name is Fire and I like websites so much I made my own.

My website is mobile-friendly and accessible. Works best with Javascript enabled (but works fine without it too). Mainly tested on Firefox, but also tested on Chrome and Safari so it should work on basically anything.

I swear on occasion and there may be occasional suggestive themes.

Now

I've been obsessively playing The Mesage from Deep Space. It's so good. I think my favorite character is Bautista, I feel a real kinship towards him. I have to take actual notes on paper and bring out my calc (slang for calculator if you didn't know) for it LOL.

I never thought I would be excited to do math before, but I guess I kind of am now.

I can't stop messing around with the colors on my site; if you see it change a lot I apologize.
